top_signals.title: CPI Can Give Fed ‘Easy Out’ on a Rate Hike, BMO’s Davis Says
top_signals.summary: Earl Davis, fixed income and money markets head at BMO Global Asset Management, looks ahead to US CPI data on Friday and explains why he’s watching mortgage convexity sellers. He speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
